name: Mega Lucario ex v12
derivation: v11 with -1 Rocky Fighting Energy, +1 Team Rocket's Petrel

key_attacks.name: Aura Jab
key_attacks.rider: Attach up to 3 Basic [F] Energy from your discard pile to your Benched Pokemon in any way you like.

key_attacks.name: Mega Brave
key_attacks.rider: During your next turn, this Pokemon can't use Mega Brave.

key_attacks.name: Wild Press
key_attacks.rider: This Pokemon also does 70 damage to itself.

key_attacks.name: Cosmic Beam
key_attacks.rider: Does nothing if you have no Lunatone on your Bench. Damage is not affected by Weakness or Resistance.

key_attacks.name: Tuck Tail
key_attacks.rider: Put this Pokemon and all attached cards into your hand.

key_abilities.name: Lunar Cycle
key_abilities.text: Once during your turn, if you have Solrock in play, you may discard a Basic [F] Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Draw 3 cards. You can't use more than 1 Lunar Cycle Ability each turn.

key_abilities.name: Heave-Ho Catcher
key_abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokemon from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokemon, you may use this Ability. Switch in 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon to the Active Spot.

key_abilities.name: Last-Ditch Catch
key_abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play this Pokemon from your hand onto your Bench, search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it and put it into your hand.
